_notes: Native NVRAM mapping for Avengers (Stern SAM).

SAM stores the 4 player scores as 4 x 8-byte (64-bit little-endian) fields: stride 8, not 4. The prior stride-4/length-4 layout mis-read players 2-4 (P2 read the zero high-bytes of P1, etc.). Corrected and validated against real 2-/3-/4-player Metallica dumps (mtl_180h).

Stern SAM number-of-players-in-game at fixed NVRAM address 0x02110900 (adjacent to game_over 0x02110904 in the SAM game-state header). Identified from three real played dumps: the only byte that reads exactly 2 / 3 / 4 in 2-, 3- and 4-player games (mtl_180h).
player_count.label: Player Count

_notes: Stern SAM platform-wide game-in-progress flag at fixed NVRAM address 0x02110904, bit 0x40 (set = game over / no game in progress). The address is independent of the per-game live-score layout and was validated by live headless exercise (boot -> play -> game-over) on mtl_180h, trn_174 and xmn_150: bit 0x40 is set in attract/game-over and clear throughout active play (trn_174 0/242 and xmn_150 0/242 play snapshots set).
game_over.label: Game Over

_notes: Stern SAM platform-wide credits counter at fixed NVRAM address 0x0211100C (redundant copy at 0x02111014). Identified by the stimulus-response harness (identify_game_state.py): the byte rises as coins are inserted and drops by exactly 1 when a game starts - a pricing-agnostic signature. Confirmed on mtl_180h, trn_174, avs_170, xmn_150.
